intent: Specify the buffer-free streaming COBS (Consistent Overhead Byte Stuffing) API of the `cobs` crate: the encoder state machine `cobs::EncoderState` (`Default::default`, `push`, `finalize`, together with the `PushResult` protocol it documents), the decoder state machine `cobs::DecoderState` (`Default::default`, `feed`), and the size bounds `cobs::max_encoding_overhead` and `cobs::max_encoding_length`. In Lean: `cobs.enc.EncoderState.Insts.CoreDefaultDefault.default`, `cobs.enc.EncoderState.push st b` (returns the `PushResult` and the new state), `cobs.enc.EncoderState.finalize st`, `cobs.dec.DecoderState.Insts.CoreDefaultDefault.default`, `cobs.dec.DecoderState.feed st b` (returns the result and the new state), `cobs.max_encoding_overhead n`, `cobs.max_encoding_length n` (`n : Std.Usize`).

manual_mutants.note: full-block threshold off by one: blocks of 253 data bytes get the 0xFE code (which implies a zero)
after a full 254-byte block the distance to the next code byte is off by one
run length not reset after a zero byte: later code bytes are too large
first code byte of a frame read as a run length one too large
an idle sentinel starts a new (empty) frame instead of being ignored: repeated zeros deliver spurious empty frames
overhead computed per 255 bytes instead of 254: bound too small for long messages

bug_variants.note: before PR #49 max_encoding_overhead(0) was 0, so max_encoding_length(0) = 0 although the encoding of an empty message is the single code byte 0x01 (the documented buffer-size bound is violated)

edits.with_text:
def max_encoding_overhead (source_len : Std.Usize) : RustM Std.Usize := do
  core.num.Usize.div_ceil source_len 254#usize

bug_variants.note: before the switch to div_ceil, max_encoding_overhead computed (n + 254 - 1) / 254, which overflows (panics in debug builds) for n > usize::MAX - 253 although the overhead itself is representable

edits.with_text:
def max_encoding_overhead (source_len : Std.Usize) : RustM Std.Usize := do
  let i ← source_len + 254#usize
  let i1 ← i - 1#usize
  i1 / 254#usize
